Method of Attack: Exploiting protocol flaws and implementation weaknesses, including long exponent lengths, lack of public key validation, and large parameter sizes
Impacted Systems: Servers using older versions of protocols like TLS prior to 1.3, cryptographic libraries with long exponents, libraries with improper public key validation, libraries using large parameter sizes like ffdhe6144 or ffdhe8192
Attack Vector: Denial-of-service attack leveraging computational demands of Diffie-Hellman key agreement protocol
